test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given, followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to consider the statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is implicit in the statement.

Statement:

Nowadays, Indian cricket team plays very well.

Assumptions:

(I) The teams of other countries are not interested towards cricket.

(II) It is happening by chance.

options.text: Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
Neither assumptions I nor II are implicit.

solution:
Given Statement: Nowadays, Indian cricket team plays very well.

Now, 

Assumptions:

1. The teams of other countries are not interested towards cricket - Not Implicit (The statement only mentions the performance of the Indian cricket team and does not imply anything about the interest level of teams from other countries)

2. It is happening by chance - Not Implicit (The statement does not suggest that the Indian team's good performance is happening by chance. It simply states that they are playing well)

Here, Neither assumptions I nor II are implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
